source.author: verg
source.text: Certe hinc Romanos olim, volventibus annis, hinc fore ductores, revocato a sanguine Teucri, qui mare, qui terras omni dicione tenerent, pollicitus, quae te, genitor, sententia vertit?
source.text_original: Certe hinc Romanos olim, volventibus annis, / hinc fore ductores, revocato a sanguine Teucri, / qui mare, qui terras omni dicione tenerent, / pollicitus, quae te, genitor, sententia vertit?
source.text_english: Surely from here, in rolling years, I once promised that Romans would spring, leaders from here, with Teucrian blood restored, who would hold sea and lands under all rule. What thought has turned you, father?

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: summie sator, cui nostra dies volventibus annis tot peragit reficitque vices, tuane ista voluntas?
reuse.text_original: 'summie sator, cui nostra dies volventibus annis / tot peragit reficitque vices, tuane ista voluntas?
reuse.text_english: Supreme creator, whose day with the years rolling on carries out and renews so many turns for us, is this your will?
